headline: Transport Minister Anthony Loke Resigns After Najib House Arrest Ruling
seoTitle: Anthony Loke Resigns Amid Najib House Arrest News
metaDescription: Transport Minister Anthony Loke has resigned from his post immediately following a High Court order allowing former PM Najib Razak to serve home detention.
aiSummaryBullets: Transport Minister Anthony Loke officially resigned his cabinet position following the High Court's issuance of a house arrest order for Najib Razak.
Loke had previously submitted his resignation in September to protest a royal pardon granted to the former prime minister but remained temporarily.
The High Court ruling follows a series of legal developments and administrative debates regarding the status of Najib Razak's remaining prison term.
aiContextParagraph: The resignation of Anthony Loke as Malaysia's transport minister follows a contentious period involving the legal status of former Prime Minister Najib Razak. Najib, who had been serving a prison term, sought a transfer to house arrest, a move that prompted significant public and political debate. While initial efforts for his transfer encountered delays and jurisdictional questions between the Attorney General's Chambers and the Prisons Department, a recent High Court order has cleared the path for him to serve the remainder of his sentence in home detention. This development triggered the immediate departure of Loke, who serves as the secretary-general of the DAP. Loke had signaled his intention to vacate his cabinet role in September as a gesture of protest against the conditional royal pardon previously granted to Najib. He had continued his official duties only at the specific request of Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim until the recent judicial resolution.
whyItIsViral: The resignation of a high-ranking cabinet member combined with the high-profile legal status of a former prime minister has driven significant media coverage and public interest.
